description: NHCCI is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by FHWA, Office of Transportation Policy Studies. The National Highway Construction Cost Index (NHCCI) is a price index that can be used both to track price changes associated with highway construction costs, and to convert current dollar expenditures on highway construction to real or constant dollar expenditures. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 50 columns, among them grp25-pct-change-Misc-Stone-Riprap, grp25-pct-change-Buildings-Misc-Structures, grp25-pct-change-Electrical, grp25-pct-change-Utility, grp25-pct-change-Concrete_Pavement, grp25-pct-change-Asphalt. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last data update. Attribution given: FHWA, Office of Transportation Policy Studies. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
